title: 22 Years Ago, A Cartoon Network Classic Debut (And Fans Are Awaiting Its Spin-Off)
content: Cartoon Network has spent decades creating the most original animated series the world has ever seen. With the likes of The Powerpuff Girls, Ed, Edd, ‘n Eddy, Dexter’s Laboratory , and too many others to count, the channel is still producing wild new series to this day.

title: Com2uS Pushes Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Game to 2028
content: Com2uS, a Korean gaming company, has delayed its Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint game to 2028, a year later than the 2027 window the company had previously pointed to in May, according to its second-quarter 2026 earnings presentation released on August 12.
author: ANN

title: Record of Lodoss War: Queen of Death Webtoon Launches in English
content: KADOKAWA announced on August 4 the global release of Record of Lodoss War : Queen of Death , the first webtoon from Studio White , a joint production studio established by KADOKAWA , LINE Digital Frontier , and REDICE STUDIO .

title: One Piece x SpongeBob SquarePants Crossover Confirms American Arrival
content: Earlier this summer, we here at ComicBook.com reported on an official anime crossover that many were shocked to see was becoming a reality. While many anime events might only be exclusive to Japan, this particular crossover has confirmed that it is making its way to North America.

title: WIT STUDIO Teases Attack on Titan Announcement for August 20 With Special Dinner Visual
content: WIT STUDIO is teasing a new Attack on Titan announcement for August 20, 2026, revealing a visual featuring six characters from the series. The franchise recently got a special visual by MAPPA for the studio’s 15th anniversary , along with confirming new animation for the upcoming Attack on Titan 3 game.
author: Anime Corner

title: One Piece novel Zoro Tops Oricon's Monthly Light Novel Ranking for July 2026
content: Writer Jun Esaka and artist Nakamaru's ONE PIECE novel ZORO ranked at #1 with 47,965 copies. Shueisha published the novel on July 3. The novel depicts Zoro's life and adventures before meeting Luffy. Esaka also wrote the One Piece: Heroines light novel series with illustration by Sayaka Suwa .

title: Canceled HBO Max Series is Coming to Toonami
content: In the era of streaming, it seems as though there is so much content out there that subscribers might feel like they can never catch up. Unfortunately, this same benefit can mean that some animated series can be lost in the shuffle.

title: One Piece Manga Tops Oricon's Monthly Comic Ranking for July 2026
content: The 115th volume of Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga ranked at #1 selling 1,020,422 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on July 3. The One Piece manga has surpassed 600 million copies published worldwide as of the release of the 114th volume on March 4. The One Piece anime's Elbaph arc debuted in Japan on April 5.
author: ANN
